import re
for line in content.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$", line.strip())
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=float(m.group(2))
        shares[name]=amt
print('parsed shares', shares)

page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access_token, direction='received', query='Friends Dinner', min_created_at=yesterday_date, max_created_at=yesterday_date, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)

            paid_sender_emails.add(t['sender']['email'])

        user_email=email,

# Verify that the payment requests we created are present in Venmo sent payment requests.
created_ids = {6097,6098,6099,6100}
venmo_access_token = venmo_access_token
all_reqs=[]
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        query='Friends Dinner',
        status='pending',
        page_index=i,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    items = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('success', [])
    if not items:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(items)
    i+=1
print('pending_sent_payment_requests_matching_query', len(all_reqs))
# show matches by id
matches=[r for r in all_reqs if r.get('payment_request_id') in created_ids]
print('matches_by_created_ids_count', len(matches))
print('matches', [
    {k: m.get(k) for k in ['payment_request_id','amount','description','created_at','receiver','status','approved_at','denied_at'] if k in m}
    for m in matches
])
# also print receiver emails for matches
print('match_receiver_emails', [m.get('receiver',{}).get('email') for m in matches])
